messages:
Leah (SRE): Postmortem up: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-batch-latency. Need SLO edits + owners.
Tom R: Saw tail spikes at 03:00 UTC. Current SLOs average latency only — hides P99.9.
Ivy L: Recommend adding per-route P99.9 SLO + sustained throughput SLI. Also put high-burn tenants on a watchlist for outreach.
Leah (SRE): Draft SLOs: route_p99_9 target <=1200ms at 99.6%; sustained_throughput 5m >= 90% baseline (baseline = median weekday 02:00-04:00). Validation window 10 days in shadow.
Tom R: PromQL for p99.9 (5m): histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
Ivy L: I'll add a heatmap panel "Hourly tail latency" and a watchlist that flags tenants with >30% error budget burn. Dashboard id: grafana/d/ef01/throughput-watch.
Leah (SRE): Action items:
- Tom R: alert rules + staging push (due 2026-04-08)
- Ivy L: dashboard + watchlist job + customer outreach template (due 2026-04-09)
- Leah: update postmortem with SLO proposal and open tracking ticket RED-4401 (due 2026-04-07)
React with :white_check_mark: to accept.
Tom R: :white_check_mark: owning alerts.
Ivy L: :white_check_mark: taking dashboards + outreach.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0406-01 linked.
runbook-bot: Runbook note queued: add section "Batch window (02:45-03:15 UTC)" with mitigations: tenant caps, fallback routing, temporary scale + contact list.
Leah (SRE): We should add a predictive burn alert: if burn rate slope > 8%/day trigger page for enterprise tier. Ivy, add to SLO doc?
Ivy L: Will add predictive alert and tiered paging rules to docs.
Leah (SRE): Meeting set to review SLO numbers after validation: 2026-04-18 11:00 UTC. Thanks.
